newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh sees 96/97 inflation rate below 4.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh sees 96/97 inflation rate below 4.0 pct.

text.p: Bangladesh's inflation rate is expected to remain below 4.0 percent by the end of fiscal 1996/97 (July-June), Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria said on Wednesday.
"The rate of inflation was 3.17 percent in March and it will be definitely below 4.0 percent by the end of June," Kibria told Reuters.

He said: "This is an indication of healthy economy. We will maintain our non-inflationary growth strategy. The government is very careful about the movement of price of essentials and that it does not hurt the consumers."
